messages:
Asha K.: Quick pitch: run a microlaunch ("Sparklet") that bundles a short launch post + 50 free credits + a 20-min webinar. Condition: users must run one of our curated prompt templates to redeem. Objective: lift 7-day active rate and capture demo-intent signals. Two-week experiment.
Ben T.: sounds good. Which arming? gift up-front vs gift-on-first-success? Any geo targeting?
Asha K.: split test both. Geo: NA + EU. Keep APAC for next wave. Metrics: primary = 7-day active %, secondary = demo requests and avg tokens used.
Cecilia R.: I'll draft 3 post angles: "hands-on benchmark" (cost/latency), "Playground quick-win" (how-to), and "customer story-lite" (mini-case). CTA variants: "Get 50 credits" / "Try prompt pack + credits" / "Save a seat".
Diego M.: ops checklist: form -> zapier -> Segment identify -> add cohort sparklet_v1. Need param utm_campaign=sparklet_launch. Credits pool: allocate from promo budget, expiry 10 days. Confirm redemption flow?
Eli P.: legal gave greenlight for promo. Note: make sure credits are one-time use and tied to user id to avoid abuse. I'll add a throttle on promo code generation.
Asha K.: funnel flow proposal: 1) launch post with form, 2) immediate email with claim code + starter prompts, 3) in-app tooltip pointing to prompt templates, 4) webinar 7 days in to show advanced benchmarks.
Ben T.: timeline: go-live post = 2026-05-03, webinar = 2026-05-10, analysis cut = 2026-05-24. Quick asks: Cecilia -> creatives by 2026-04-29, Diego -> tracking hook by 2026-05-01.
Cecilia R.: noted. I'll add GIFs and a 3-slide benchmark image for the post. Prefer short copy for LinkedIn + dev twitter.
Diego M.: routing rule snippet I put in ops ticket:
route if utm_campaign == sparklet_launch OR ref == webinar_4121 -> add_cohort:sparklet_v1, emit:event:promo_shown
Eli P.: also require captcha on form to reduce spam.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Webinar created (ID: 4121). RSVP: https://events.redwood.ai/r/4121. Reminders set: 24h and 1h.
Asha K.: measurement plan: Sam (analytics) to add funnel: impressions -> form submits -> credit claimed -> first-success -> day7 active -> demo request. Capture token spend and average latency for first 3 runs.
Ben T.: for power calc, assume baseline day7 active = 10%. To detect +3 percentage points with 80% power we need ~2500 per arm. We probably won't hit that; call it exploratory.
Cecilia R.: copy draft link: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/sparklet-drafts. Preferring "Playground quick-win" for initial.
Diego M.: ops: mapping fields: email, name, company, utm_campaign, ref, timezone. Send over CSV schema today.
Eli P.: final: keep messaging simple on the bench claim. One-line cost-savings stat + screenshot of console.
Asha K.: perfect. Kickoff sync tomorrow 9:30am. Quick wins: Cecilia upload creatives, Diego wire tracking, Eli confirm promo config. :rocket:
